row: Welcome to Bridge City Veterinary Rehabilitation! We help dogs and cats recover from injury, surgery, arthritis, neurological conditions, and mobility challenges through personalized, evidence-based rehabilitation programs. On this channel, you'll find patient success stories, rehabilitation tips, behind-the-scenes videos, and educational content to help pet owners better understand veterinary rehabilitation. Based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, we're passionate about helping pets get back to doing what they love.
